mapper.insert: REPLACE INTO Alltotle (userId, userName, partenId, partenName, deptId, deptName) SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.user_name AS userName, p.dept_id AS partenId, p.dept_name AS partenName, u.dept_id AS deptId, d.dept_name AS deptName FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON u.dept_id = d.dept_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept p ON d.parent_id = p.dept_id where u.user_id != 1

REPLACE INTO Alltotle_score (userId, userName, partenId, partenName, deptId, deptName) SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.user_name AS userName, p.dept_id AS partenId, p.dept_name AS partenName, u.dept_id AS deptId, d.dept_name AS deptName FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON u.dept_id = d.dept_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept p ON d.parent_id = p.dept_id where u.user_id != 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM Alltotle WHERE userId NOT IN ( SELECT user_id FROM sys_user) or userId = 1
DELETE FROM Alltotle_score WHERE userId NOT IN ( SELECT user_id FROM sys_user) or userId = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE Alltotle a -- 横向课题统计子查询（有数据显示实际结果，无数据显示默认值） JOIN ( SELECT user_id, -- 2万元以下区间：有数据拼实际结果，无数据显示"0个(0万)" IFNULL( -- 仅拼接符合条件的结果（无符合条件时GROUP_CONCAT返回NULL） GROUP_CONCAT( CASE WHEN amount < 2 AND amount != 0 THEN CONCAT(cnt, '个（', ROUND(amount, 2), '万）') END SEPARATOR '，' ), '0个(0万)' -- 兜底：GROUP_CONCAT为NULL时显示默认值 ) AS ewyyx_formatted, -- 2-5万元（含2万）：同上逻辑 IFNULL( GROUP_CONCAT( CASE WHEN amount >= 2 AND amount < 5 THEN CONCAT(cnt, '个（', ROUND(amount, 2), '万）') END SEPARATOR '，' ), '0个(0万)' ) AS edwwy_formatted, -- 5-10万元（含5万） IFNULL( GROUP_CONCAT( CASE WHEN amount >= 5 AND amount < 10 THEN CONCAT(cnt, '个（', ROUND(amount, 2), '万）') END SEPARATOR '，' ), '0个(0万)' ) AS wdswy_formatted, -- 10-20万元（含10万） IFNULL( GROUP_CONCAT( CASE WHEN amount >= 10 AND amount < 20 THEN CONCAT(cnt, '个（', ROUND(amount, 2), '万）') END SEPARATOR '，' ), '0个(0万)' ) AS sdeswy_formatted, -- 20-35万元（含20万） IFNULL( GROUP_CONCAT( CASE WHEN amount >= 20 AND amount < 35 THEN CONCAT(cnt, '个（', ROUND(amount, 2), '万）') END SEPARATOR '，' ), '0个(0万)' ) AS esdsswwy_formatted, -- 35-50万元（含35万） IFNULL( GROUP_CONCAT( CASE WHEN amount >= 35 AND amount < 50 THEN CONCAT(cnt, '个（', ROUND(amount, 2), '万）') END SEPARATOR '，' ), '0个(0万)' ) AS wswwydwswy_formatted, -- 50-75万元（含50万） IFNULL( GROUP_CONCAT( CASE WHEN amount >= 50 AND amount < 75 THEN CONCAT(cnt, '个（', ROUND(amount, 2), '万）') END SEPARATOR '，' ), '0个(0万)' ) AS wsdqswwy_formatted, -- 75-100万元（含75万） IFNULL( GROUP_CONCAT( CASE WHEN amount >= 75 AND amount < 100 THEN CONCAT(cnt, '个（', ROUND(amount, 2), '万）') END SEPARATOR '，' ), '0个(0万)' ) AS qswdybwy_formatted FROM ( -- 内层子查询：按user_id+amount分组统计实际课题（单位：万元） SELECT user_id, amount, COUNT(*) AS cnt -- 相同金额的课题个数 FROM sci_horizontal_apply WHERE state = 6 GROUP BY user_id, amount -- 补充：确保无任何课题的user_id也能被统计（避免关联丢失） UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT user_id, 0 AS amount, -- 占位金额（不影响区间判断） 0 AS cnt -- 占位数量 FROM sci_horizontal_apply ) AS amount_group GROUP BY user_id ) h ON a.userId = h.user_id SET -- 清理可能的末尾多余逗号（有数据时生效，无数据时默认值无逗号） a.ewyyx = TRIM(TRAILING '，' FROM h.ewyyx_formatted), a.edwwy = TRIM(TRAILING '，' FROM h.edwwy_formatted), a.wdswy = TRIM(TRAILING '，' FROM h.wdswy_formatted), a.sdeswy = TRIM(TRAILING '，' FROM h.sdeswy_formatted), a.esdsswwy = TRIM(TRAILING '，' FROM h.esdsswwy_formatted), a.wswwydwswy = TRIM(TRAILING '，' FROM h.wswwydwswy_formatted), a.wsdqswwy = TRIM(TRAILING '，' FROM h.wsdqswwy_formatted), a.qswdybwy = TRIM(TRAILING '，' FROM h.qswdybwy_formatted)

-- 更新alltotle_score表中的横向课题总积分 UPDATE Alltotle_score a -- 关联积分统计子查询 left JOIN ( -- 计算每个用户的横向课题总积分 SELECT ush.user_id, SUM(ush.change_value) AS total_score FROM sci_horizontal_apply sha JOIN sci_user_score_history ush ON sha.id = ush.apply_id WHERE -- 条件1：change_status为立项 且 signing_data在2025年 (ush.change_status = '立项' AND YEAR(DATE_ADD(signing_data,INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) = 2025) -- 条件2：change_status为结项 且 validity_Date在2025年 OR (ush.change_status = '结项' AND YEAR(DATE_ADD(validity_Date,INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) = 2025) GROUP BY ush.user_id ) h ON a.userId = h.user_id SET a.hxkt = COALESCE(h.total_score, 0)

UPDATE Alltotle a JOIN ( SELECT user_id, -- 1. 主持国家基金科研项目（匹配字典键值对应的标签逻辑，通过子查询关联拿到 dict_label） IFNULL( GROUP_CONCAT( CASE -- 这里要先确保能关联到 dict_label，通过子查询里关联的 dd 表字段 WHEN type_amount_group.dict_label = '主持国家基金科研项目' THEN CONCAT(cnt, '个（', ROUND(type_amount_group.amount, 2), '万）') END SEPARATOR '，' ), '0个(0万)' ) AS zcgjjjkyxm_formatted, -- 2. 主持省部级基金科研项目 IFNULL( GROUP_CONCAT( CASE WHEN type_amount_group.dict_label = '主持省部级基金科研项目' THEN CONCAT(cnt, '个（', ROUND(type_amount_group.amount, 2), '万）') END SEPARATOR '，' ), '0个(0万)' ) AS zcsbjjjkyxm_formatted, -- 3. 主持省部级教改项目 IFNULL( GROUP_CONCAT( CASE WHEN type_amount_group.dict_label = '主持省部级教改项目' THEN CONCAT(cnt, '个（', ROUND(type_amount_group.amount, 2), '万）') END SEPARATOR '，' ), '0个(0万)' ) AS zcsbjjgxm_formatted, -- 4. 主持省部级纵向科研项目 IFNULL( GROUP_CONCAT( CASE WHEN type_amount_group.dict_label = '主持省部级纵向科研项目' THEN CONCAT(cnt, '个（', ROUND(type_amount_group.amount, 2), '万）') END SEPARATOR '，' ), '0个(0万)' ) AS zcsbjzxkyxm_formatted, -- 5. 主持厅局级、学会级科研项目 IFNULL( GROUP_CONCAT( CASE WHEN type_amount_group.dict_label = '主持厅局级、学会级科研项目' THEN CONCAT(cnt, '个（', ROUND(type_amount_group.amount, 2), '万）') END SEPARATOR '，' ), '0个(0万)' ) AS zctjjxhjkyxm_formatted, -- 6. 主持校级教学管理项目（1万元以上） IFNULL( GROUP_CONCAT( CASE WHEN type_amount_group.dict_label = '主持校级教学管理项目（1万元以上）' THEN CONCAT(cnt, '个（', ROUND(type_amount_group.amount, 2), '万）') END SEPARATOR '，' ), '0个(0万)' ) AS zcxjjxglxmywyys_formatted, -- 7. 主持校级教学管理项目（1万元以下） IFNULL( GROUP_CONCAT( CASE WHEN type_amount_group.dict_label = '主持校级教学管理项目（1万元以下）' THEN CONCAT(cnt, '个（', ROUND(type_amount_group.amount, 2), '万）') END SEPARATOR '，' ), '0个(0万)' ) AS zcxjjxglxmywyyx_formatted FROM ( SELECT v.user_id, v.top_type, v.amount, dd.dict_label, -- 新增选取出 dict_label，让外层能使用 COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM sci_horizontal_apply_vertical v -- 关联字典数据表，筛选 dict_type 为 sci_vertical_type 的数据，这里关联条件是匹配 dict_value JOIN sys_dict_data dd ON v.top_type = dd.dict_value AND dd.dict_type = 'sci_vertical_type' -- 限定纵向课题分类字典类型 WHERE v.state = 66 GROUP BY v.user_id, v.top_type, v.amount, dd.dict_label -- 分组里加上 dict_label ) AS type_amount_group GROUP BY user_id ) v ON a.userId = v.user_id SET a.zcgjjjkyxm = TRIM(TRAILING '，' FROM v.zcgjjjkyxm_formatted), a.zcsbjjjkyxm = TRIM(TRAILING '，' FROM v.zcsbjjjkyxm_formatted), a.zcsbjjgxm = TRIM(TRAILING '，' FROM v.zcsbjjgxm_formatted), a.zcsbjzxkyxm = TRIM(TRAILING '，' FROM v.zcsbjzxkyxm_formatted), a.zctjjxhjkyxm = TRIM(TRAILING '，' FROM v.zctjjxhjkyxm_formatted), a.zcxjjxglxmywyys = TRIM(TRAILING '，' FROM v.zcxjjxglxmywyys_formatted), a.zcxjjxglxmywyyx = TRIM(TRAILING '，' FROM v.zcxjjxglxmywyyx_formatted)

-- 更新alltotle_score表中的纵向课题-校级以上总积分 UPDATE Alltotle_score a -- 关联积分统计子查询 left JOIN ( -- 计算每个用户的横向课题总积分 SELECT ush.user_id, SUM(ush.change_value) AS total_score FROM sci_user_score_vertical ush JOIN sci_horizontal_apply_vertical shav ON ush.vertical_id = shav.id WHERE shav.top_type not in (6,7) and -- 条件1：change_status为立项 且 signing_data在2025年 (ush.change_status = '立项' AND YEAR(DATE_ADD(signing_data,INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) = 2025) -- 条件2：change_status为结项 且 validity_Date在2025年 OR (ush.change_status = '结项' AND YEAR(DATE_ADD(validity_data,INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) = 2025) GROUP BY ush.user_id ) h ON a.userId = h.user_id SET a.zxktxjys = COALESCE(h.total_score, 0)

-- 更新alltotle_score表中的纵向课题-校级以上总积分 UPDATE Alltotle_score a -- 关联积分统计子查询 left JOIN ( -- 计算每个用户的横向课题总积分 SELECT ush.user_id, SUM(ush.change_value) AS total_score FROM sci_user_score_vertical ush JOIN sci_horizontal_apply_vertical shav ON ush.vertical_id = shav.id WHERE shav.top_type in (6,7) and -- 条件1：change_status为立项 且 signing_data在2025年 (ush.change_status = '立项' AND YEAR(DATE_ADD(signing_data,INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) = 2025) -- 条件2：change_status为结项 且 validity_Date在2025年 OR (ush.change_status = '结项' AND YEAR(DATE_ADD(validity_data,INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) = 2025) GROUP BY ush.user_id ) h ON a.userId = h.user_id SET a.zxktxj = COALESCE(h.total_score, 0)

UPDATE Alltotle a JOIN ( SELECT user_id, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN fenlei = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS count_fenlei_1, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN fenlei = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS count_fenlei_2, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN fenlei = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS count_fenlei_3, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN fenlei = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS count_fenlei_4 FROM sci_zhuanliruanzhu WHERE state = 6 GROUP BY user_id ) b ON a.userId = b.user_id SET a.sqfmzl = COALESCE(b.count_fenlei_1, 0), a.syxxzl = COALESCE(b.count_fenlei_2, 0), a.wxsjzl = COALESCE(b.count_fenlei_3, 0), a.jsjrjzzq = COALESCE(b.count_fenlei_4, 0)

-- 更新alltotle_score表中的专利总积分 update Alltotle_score a join( SELECT sz.user_id , SUM(sz.jifen) as score FROM sci_zhuanliruanzhu sz where sz.fenlei not in (4) group by user_id ) s on a.userId = s.user_id set a.zl = COALESCE(s.score, 0)

UPDATE Alltotle_score a INNER JOIN ( SELECT user_id, SUM(year_part) AS score FROM ( SELECT b.user_id, b.stats_year, 0.5 * SUM(b.expv) AS year_part FROM ( SELECT s.user_id, CASE WHEN MONTH(s.kyjc_pass_time) = 12 THEN YEAR(s.kyjc_pass_time) + 1 ELSE YEAR(s.kyjc_pass_time) END AS stats_year, CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(s.expected_jifen), '') AS DECIMAL(12, 2)) AS expv, s.id FROM sci_zhuanliruanzhu s WHERE s.fenlei IN ('4') AND s.state = '6' AND s.kyjc_pass_time IS NOT NULL AND s.expected_jifen IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(s.expected_jifen) <> '' ) b WHERE ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT s2.user_id, CASE WHEN MONTH(s2.kyjc_pass_time) = 12 THEN YEAR(s2.kyjc_pass_time) + 1 ELSE YEAR(s2.kyjc_pass_time) END AS stats_year, CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(s2.expected_jifen), '') AS DECIMAL(12, 2)) AS expv, s2.id FROM sci_zhuanliruanzhu s2 WHERE s2.fenlei IN ('4') AND s2.state = '6' AND s2.kyjc_pass_time IS NOT NULL AND s2.expected_jifen IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(s2.expected_jifen) <> '' ) c WHERE c.user_id = b.user_id AND c.stats_year = b.stats_year AND (c.expv > b.expv OR (c.expv = b.expv AND c.id < b.id)) ) < 5 GROUP BY b.user_id, b.stats_year ) by_year GROUP BY user_id ) s ON a.userId = s.user_id SET a.rz = COALESCE(s.score, 0)

UPDATE Alltotle a JOIN ( SELECT user_id, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN fenlei = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS fenlei_1, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN fenlei = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS fenlei_2, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN fenlei = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS fenlei_3, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN fenlei = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS fenlei_4, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN fenlei = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS fenlei_5, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN fenlei = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS fenlei_6, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN fenlei = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS fenlei_7 FROM sci_jiaocairuanzhu WHERE state = 6 GROUP BY user_id ) AS stats ON a.userId = stats.user_id SET a.cbzz1 = COALESCE(stats.fenlei_1, 0), a.cbzz2 = COALESCE(stats.fenlei_2, 0), a.cbyz1 = COALESCE(stats.fenlei_3, 0), a.cbyz2 = COALESCE(stats.fenlei_4, 0), a.cbjc1 = COALESCE(stats.fenlei_5, 0), a.cbjc2 = COALESCE(stats.fenlei_6, 0), a.zbjc = COALESCE(stats.fenlei_7, 0)

-- 更新alltotle_score表中的教材专著总积分 update Alltotle_score a join( SELECT sj.user_id , SUM(sj.jifen) as score FROM sci_jiaocairuanzhu sj group by user_id )s on a.userId = s.user_id set a.jczz = COALESCE(s.score, 0)

UPDATE Alltotle a JOIN ( SELECT user_id, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN reward_fenlei = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS fenlei_1, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN reward_fenlei = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS fenlei_2, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN reward_fenlei = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS fenlei_3, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN reward_fenlei = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS fenlei_4, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN reward_fenlei = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS fenlei_5, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN reward_fenlei = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS fenlei_6, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN reward_fenlei = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS fenlei_7, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN reward_fenlei = 8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS fenlei_8 FROM sys_reward WHERE state = 6 GROUP BY user_id ) AS stats ON a.userId = stats.user_id SET a.sjjxcgj = COALESCE(stats.fenlei_1, 0), a.sjkxjsj = COALESCE(stats.fenlei_2, 0), a.stjjzrkxlpj = COALESCE(stats.fenlei_3, 0), a.stjjsklpj = COALESCE(stats.fenlei_4, 0), a.xjjxcgj = COALESCE(stats.fenlei_5, 0), a.yyxkyxjcgj = COALESCE(stats.fenlei_6, 0), a.xhjjxcgj = COALESCE(stats.fenlei_7, 0), a.xhjkycgj = COALESCE(stats.fenlei_8, 0)
-- 更新alltotle_score表中的奖励总积分 update Alltotle_score a join( SELECT sr.user_id , SUM(sr.jifen) as score FROM sys_reward sr group by user_id )s on a.userId = s.user_id set a.jl = COALESCE(s.score, 0)

UPDATE Alltotle a JOIN ( SELECT p.user_id, p.teacher_name, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN d.dict_label IN ('SCI分区Ⅰ区', 'SCI分区Ⅱ区', 'SCI分区Ⅲ区', 'SCI分区Ⅳ区') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS `SCI`, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN d.dict_label = 'EI期刊论文' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS `EI`, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN d.dict_label = '核心期刊文章（北大、 南大核心；社科类）' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS `hx`, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN d.dict_label = '三网收录论文' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS `sw`, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN d.dict_label = '普通期刊' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS `pt`, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN d.dict_label = '校办期刊' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS `xb` FROM sci_paper_a p LEFT JOIN sys_dict_data d ON d.dict_type = 'sci_paper_k' AND p.paper_category = d.dict_value WHERE p.state = 8 GROUP BY p.user_id, p.teacher_name ORDER BY p.user_id ) sp ON a.userId = sp.user_id SET a.SCI = COALESCE(sp.SCI, 0), a.EI = COALESCE(sp.EI, 0), a.hx = COALESCE(sp.hx, 0), a.sw = COALESCE(sp.sw, 0), a.pt = COALESCE(sp.pt, 0), a.xb = COALESCE(sp.xb, 0)

-- 更新alltotle_score表中的学术论文总积分 update Alltotle_score a join( SELECT spa.user_id , SUM(pa.score) as score FROM sci_paper_a spa join paper_author pa on pa.paper_id = spa.id group by user_id )sp on a.userId = sp.user_id set a.xslw = COALESCE(sp.score, 0)

UPDATE Alltotle a JOIN ( SELECT user_id, -- 统计举办国际 CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN report_classify = 11 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS jbgj_count, -- 统计举办国内 CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN report_classify = 12 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS jbgn_count, -- 统计参加国际 CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN report_classify = 13 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS cjgj_count, -- 统计参加国内 CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN report_classify = 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS cjgn_count, -- 统计校级学术 CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN report_classify = 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS xjxs_count FROM sci_lecture_report WHERE state = 6 GROUP BY user_id ) b ON a.userId = b.user_id SET a.jbgj = COALESCE(b.jbgj_count, 0), a.jbgn = COALESCE(b.jbgn_count, 0), a.cjgj = COALESCE(b.cjgj_count, 0), a.cjgn = COALESCE(b.cjgn_count, 0), a.xjxs = COALESCE(b.xjxs_count, 0)

-- 更新alltotle_score表中的讲座报告总积分 update Alltotle_score a join( SELECT slr.user_id , SUM(slr.report_keyanfen) as score FROM sci_lecture_report slr group by user_id )s on a.userId = s.user_id set a.jzbg = COALESCE(s.score, 0)
